purpose: Define fail-closed evidence requirements for retaining an exact claimed NYC street-blockface identity without fabricating a point or granting publication authority.

scope.current_lane: TVPP MAIN between CROSS1 and CROSS2 recovery

prohibited_transformations: endpoint midpoint published as exact event point
generic street midpoint published as exact event point
Planning Labs GeoSearch midpoint used as exact authority
borough neighborhood ZIP or parent-area centroid substituted for the segment
Function 3 Segment Identifier treated as geometry before an official centerline join
distinct claims merged solely because text looks similar
unresolved or ambiguous claim dropped from the reader corpus

official_geometry_handoff.source_family: NYC Citywide Street Centerline / LION-compatible centerline
official_geometry_handoff.required_join_cardinality: one strict claim to one official segment geometry
official_geometry_handoff.note: NYC Planning's public CSCL staging model indexes centerline rows by segmentid and retains geom. A later reviewed geometry lane must join and validate those bytes; this contract does not perform or authorize that join.

publication_boundary.contract_conformant_entry_meaning: The entry is suitable for retention as non-public exact street-segment identity evidence only.
publication_boundary.future_requirement: Public street-segment rendering requires a separately reviewed official centerline geometry join, geometry integrity audit, Projector schema support for non-point exact geography, corpus QA, renderer QA, and release decision.
